# Elements Milton
> Elements Milton is a pre-construction freehold townhome community by Trinity Point Developments (a division of Greenpark Group) at Bronte Street South and Britannia Road, Milton, Ontario. 60 double-car-garage towns, 3-5 bedrooms, from the $600s. Registration open, launching October 2026.

## Key Facts
- Builder: Trinity Point Developments (a division of Greenpark Group)
- Location: 2933 Britannia Road, Milton, ON L9T 7K6 (Bronte Street South & Britannia Road)
- Home types: Freehold townhomes, double-car garage
- Bedrooms: 3 to 5
- Total units: 60
- Price range: From the $600s (as of September 2026, subject to change)
- Deposit: To be announced
- Occupancy: To be announced
- Status: Registration Open, targeting October 2026 launch
- Last updated: 2026-09-26

## Common Questions
Q: What is Elements Milton?
A: Elements Milton is a pre-construction freehold townhome community by Trinity Point Developments, a division of Greenpark Group, at Bronte Street South and Britannia Road in Milton, Ontario. The release includes 60 double-car-garage towns with 3 to 5 bedrooms, priced from the $600s.

Q: Who is the builder?
A: Trinity Point Developments, operating as a division of Greenpark Group, an established Ontario homebuilder.

Q: Where is it located?
A: 2933 Britannia Road, Milton, Ontario, L9T 7K6, at Bronte Street South and Britannia Road.

Q: How much do homes cost?
A: From the $600s for the entry-tier 3 bedroom towns, as of September 2026, subject to change.

Q: When does it launch?
A: Targeting October 2026. Registrants get priority notice of the exact VIP release date.

Q: How do I get VIP access?
A: Register with name, email, and phone through the form at https://elements-milton.ca/#register.
